name: Nature’s Favor, Communal
body:
School evocation; Level druid 4, ranger 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target animals touched
Duration 1 minute/2 levels
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as nature’s favor, except you divide the duration in 1-minute intervals among the creatures touched.
